title: Coir
subtitle: An Epic of Struggle and Heritage in Kerala
summary: Step into the heart of Kerala's vibrant backwaters, where centuries-old traditions and the daily lives of coir workers unfold in a sweeping saga of change and resilience. Kayar weaves together the destinies of families and community leaders as they face shifting power, caste tensions, and the relentless tide of time. With each passing generation, keys to sacred treasuries and ancestral honor pass from hand to hand, illuminating the struggles and hopes of those bound by both land and labor. Thakazhi Sivasankara Pillai’s masterpiece is a powerful portrait of a community’s endurance, inviting readers to witness the intimate joys and sorrows of an entire era.
